premises.text: Businesses run on messy reply-all email threads that waste time; the answer is not to abandon email but to make it more productive, collaborative, and social
premises.evidence_span: Businesses almost all run on these kind of reply all threads. And it's totally stupid. But we don't think the answer is to throw email away

premises.text: A loop is a smart mailing list with a name and email address, used through ordinary email and backed by a SaaS app that adds search, sharing, and history
premises.evidence_span: The loop is a smart mailing list easy to search, easy to share, easy to create

premises.text: Loops are created via email with no IT ticket, download, or new learning curve because interaction is just email
premises.evidence_span: There was no IT help desk request. No one had to download anything. No one had to learn anything, because it's just email

premises.text: Freemium monetization: customers pay for customization, administration, and integrations, aided by intrinsic email-list virality
premises.evidence_span: customers have told us they'll pay for customization

value.text: Make workplace email more productive, collaborative, and social so people waste less time in it
value.evidence_span: make email more productive, so you waste less time in it, more collaborative, and more social

causal_links.evidence_span: the email problem is so big
We don't ask for behavior changes, because it's just email
email lists are just intrinsically viral

notes: Transcript truncates mid-sentence at beta invite. Web search, digests, open loops, and footer sharing folded into the Loop product module (§4.1(5)). Price customization and integrations kept with freemium/virality as one commercial premise (§4.1(3)). Need/product/money triad justified: freemium packaging revisable without changing email-native creation, and reply-all waste is a separate market claim. Singleton D1 and D3 retained.
